import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final int T = 14;

    static long mod_exp(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static class SeqSolver {
        static long[] berlekampMassey(long[] seq) {
            int n = seq.length;
            List<Long> cur = new ArrayList<>();
            List<Long> ls = new ArrayList<>();
            int lf = -1;
            long ld = 0;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                long val = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); ++j)
                    val = (val + seq[i - j - 1] * cur.get(j)) % MOD;
                val = (val - seq[i]) % MOD;
                if (val == 0) continue;
                
                if (cur.isEmpty()) {
                    cur = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(i + 1, 0L));
                    lf = i;
                    ld = val;
                    continue;
                }
                
                long k = (-val * mod_exp(ld, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD;
                List<Long> c = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < i - lf - 1; ++j) c.add(0L);
                c.add(k);
                for (int j = 0; j < ls.size(); ++j)
                    c.add((-ls.get(j) * k) % MOD);
                
                if (c.size() < cur.size()) {
                    while (c.size() < cur.size()) c.add(0L);
                }
                
                for (int j = 0; j < cur.size(); ++j)
                    c.set(j, (c.get(j) + cur.get(j)) % MOD);
                
                if (cur.size() < i - lf + ls.size()) {
                    ls = new ArrayList<>(cur);
                    lf = i;
                    ld = val;
                }
                cur = c;
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.size(); i++) {
                long x = cur.get(i);
                cur.set(i, (x % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
            }
            
            long[] result = new long[cur.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.size(); i++) result[i] = cur.get(i);
            return result;
        }

        static long[] hVec;
        static long[] aVec;
        static int mLen;

        static void polyMult(long[] p, long[] q) {
            long[] tmp = new long[mLen * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < mLen; ++i) if (p[i] != 0)
                for (int j = 0; j < mLen; ++j)
                    tmp[i + j] = (tmp[i + j] + p[i] * q[j]) % MOD;
            for (int i = mLen * 2 - 1; i >= mLen; --i) if (tmp[i] != 0)
                for (int j = mLen - 1; j >= 0; --j)
                    tmp[i - j - 1] = (tmp[i - j - 1] + tmp[i] * hVec[j]) % MOD;
            for (int i = 0; i < mLen; ++i) p[i] = tmp[i];
        }

        static long eval(long K) {
            long[] s = new long[mLen];
            long[] t = new long[mLen];
            s[0] = 1;
            if (mLen != 1) t[1] = 1;
            else t[0] = hVec[0];
            
            while (K > 0) {
                if ((K & 1) == 1) polyMult(s, t);
                polyMult(t, t);
                K >>= 1;
            }
            
            long res = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < mLen; ++i)
                res = (res + s[i] * aVec[i]) % MOD;
            return (res % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }

        static long compute(long[] seq, long n) {
            if (n < seq.length) return seq[(int)n];
            hVec = berlekampMassey(seq);
            mLen = hVec.length;
            if (mLen == 0) return 0;
            aVec = new long[mLen];
            System.arraycopy(seq, 0, aVec, 0, mLen);
            return eval(n);
        }
    }

    static long countValid(long n, long upperBound) {
        long cnt = 0;
        String s = Long.toString(n);
        int len = s.length();
        if (n > 0) cnt++;
        for (int i = 1; i < T; i++) {
            long base = 1, num = n;
            for (int j = 0; j + 1 < i; j++) base *= 10;
            for (int j = len; j < i; j++) num *= 10;
            if (i < len) {
                String prefix = s.substring(0, Math.min(i, s.length()));
                num = Long.parseLong(prefix) + 1;
            }
            if (num > upperBound) num = upperBound;
            if (num > base) cnt += num - base;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] tokens = br.readLine().split(" ");
        long n = Long.parseLong(tokens[0]);
        n++;
        long limit = n;
        
        long adjustment = (n % MOD) * ((n / MOD1) + 2) % MOD;
        adjustment = (MOD - adjustment) % MOD;
        
        long total = 0;
        for (long offset = -n / MOD1 - 1; offset <= n / MOD1 + 1; offset++) {
            long count = 0;
            for (int digits = 0; digits < T; digits++) {
                long left = 0, right = 1;
                if (digits >= 1) {
                    left = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k + 1 < digits; k++) left *= 10;
                    right = left * 10;
                }
                if (right > n) right = n;
                long lastRight = right;
                if (left < right) {
                    left--;
                    while (right - left > 1) {
                        long mid = (left + right) / 2;
                        if (countValid(mid, limit) > mid + MOD1 * offset - 1) right = mid;
                        else left = mid;
                    }
                    count += lastRight - right;
                }
            }
            total += count;
        }
        
        total %= MOD;
        total = ((-total - adjustment) % MOD * MOD1) % MOD;
        total = (total % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        System.out.println(total);
    }
}
